title: Kagamine Len — My Dancing Shoes!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Welcome, you two.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello. Len's been waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, what took you so long?
Let's get down to dancing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, slow down. Before we get started, we have to choose a song and choreograph everything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's actually why we came today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We may not be able to dance together during the event, but we would appreciate your help very much, Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You got it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You know we're just singing and dancing, right? You won't get a chance to be a DJ here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm completely okay with that! I can just become the dancing DJ!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, you guys have all been getting better and better, so I thought that I should try new things and get really really good too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really really good?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Really really good!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha.
I don't see why not. It's good to take on new challenges.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You never know what might come in handy down the road.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. Even that work we did as extras the other day taught us quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that exactly!
Life is all about taking the time to stop and smell the flowers.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, in your case, KAITO, that's all you sort of do...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's not fair! I just believe that people should try new things and see new sights, including myself!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which is why you should do the same, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wanna do that too!
But maybe not quite like you, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What? You're on her side, Len?!

rows.Speaker: Len & MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But since we're in this together, why not set some goals for yourself while you're at it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: My own goals...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. For example, our goal for the moment is to perform in the Summer Festival.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...!
I can try performing for MEIKO and KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Also, Akito, Toya!
I know I can't be in the Summer Festival, but can we try coming up with a three-person version too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A three-person version?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! We can use the same song but change the dance around a little to add me. It'd be okay as long as it doesn't end up being more work, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then it'd sort of feel like I was in your event too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose it should be okay since it likely won't interfere with us practicing for the Summer Festival.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, why not? Again, we're in this together, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yay! Then it's settled!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
I'd like it if An and Kohane could come and watch!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We'll have to ask when Shiraishi is free next, then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And Kohane should be back from the Seaside School by the time the Summer Festival is over, so we can ask her then.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay!
I need to do my best during dance practice!
